	Call this tool when interacting with any of these.

	Informing the user on which MCP servers were installed (some might require enabling and/or authentication by going to Cursor -> Settings -> Cursor Settings -> Tools and MCP).
	
	If none were installed, continue the response.

	If any MCP servers were installed, stop the response and wait for the user to tell you to continue.
